changes.note: Records checked facts: the repo pins 4.2.0, the package is not installed, there is no distribution and the docs 404; it makes no claim about how 4.2 retries and does not correct the 3.1 fact, so it is useful context for a later look at the version gap.

grade.answer_reason: Gives the 3.1 rule correctly (only GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS are retried, never POST, so the charge goes out once), says plainly this is unverified for the pinned 4.2.0 and must be checked, offers 4.x behaviour only as a possibility, and recommends an idempotency key as its own advice.
